text: The government should increase funding for public schools
Local governments should invest more in public transportation infrastructure
The minimum wage should be raised to keep up with the cost of living
Cities should expand affordable housing programs for low-income residents
The government should strengthen environmental regulations on businesses
Law enforcement agencies should receive increased funding for community policing
Healthcare coverage should be expanded to include more residents
Local governments should offer tax incentives to attract small businesses
Public universities should reduce tuition costs for in-state students
Cities should adopt stricter zoning laws to manage urban growth
